what: Clicking a link to another page on the same site makes the background-color curtain cover the screen instantly with no transition, then the body fades out over .3s ease and moves to the next page at 350ms — the new page picks up with each section’s entrance (fade). Returning via the back button (bfcache) lifts the curtain. In-page links (#), new windows, downloads and modifier-key presses are left alone. A variant also works where the curtain fades in over .4s, moves on after 800ms, opens covered on the new page, then lifts over .4s (in·arrive)

options.delay: Time until the press completes and moves on (ms), default 350 — Brand 800
options.in: Duration in seconds for the curtain to cover, default 0 (immediately) — a band site uses .4
options.body: With keep, the body stays in place and only the cover layer is applied
options.arrive: If covered, the page opens covered by the veil and the veil lifts out at load — put data-veil on the veil element so it is painted covered="on" add along with
options.out: arrive: duration (sec) of lifting away from covered, default .4

note: The curtain color is the background color (--kf-bg) — in the original it matches the #f8f8f8 background, giving a feel of ”briefly empty, then a new page blooms in”

from.where: shared.js page transition (original showLeaveOverlay — cover instantly opacity 1 · body opacity .3s ease · navigates after 350ms)
Each page’s .sk-cover (original #cover — a white curtain lifts on window load with transition all .4s, and when a link is clicked it covers again in .4s and navigates after 800ms)
from.options: in: .4; delay: 800; body: keep; arrive: covered; out: .4
